description: 草鞋也能战吕布！选择三国英雄，走位躲招、自动攻击，搭配六把武器与通用技能，捡金币、逛商店，一路挑战三国群雄。搞笑开打，越搭越强！
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: finished square WeChat mini-game avatar for 桃园乱斗.
Primary request: Redesign the game's avatar to feature ALL THREE original heroes Liu Bei, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei together. ONE finished square illustration, not a sheet.
Input image role: identity and drawing-style reference. Use ONLY the three happy heroes in the TOP ROW of the supplied six-character portrait sheet. Preserve their distinct faces, hats, hair, colours and comic personality. Do not use any crying faces.
Composition: a tightly grouped trio of LARGE heads and tiny upper torsos arranged in a compact triangle. Guan Yu is at upper left, Zhang Fei at upper right, Liu Bei in front at lower centre. All three faces are clearly exposed and similarly prominent; Liu Bei only slightly larger. Heads nestle together like a lively brotherhood group portrait, with overlapping shoulders but no face occlusion. Facial eyes and mouths must read at 64-pixel avatar size. Keep all essential heads and facial details inside a centered circular safe area, with comfortable outer margin for topknots/hat; no clipped faces. Do not use full bodies or feet.
Character identities:
- Liu Bei: warm skin, green topknot ribbon, thick mischievous brows, half-lidded confident eyes, pink cheeks, tiny moustache and pointed goatee, cheeky open grin, green short robe with cream collar/red sash. Both small round fists FIRMLY GRIP two golden woven straw sandals in the lower foreground. Thumbs visibly overlap sandal edges, not dangling shoes; no rod-like arms across his face.
- Guan Yu: bright red face, stern comic lowered brows, long dark beard, recognisable green headwrap with gold band and red central jewel, green robe. A small readable section of his slim slightly bent bamboo carrying pole may show low on the left, below the faces.
- Zhang Fei: warm skin, black shaggy hair/topknot with red headband, huge bushy black beard, joyfully laughing wide open mouth and scrunched happy eyes, purple robe/red sash. A compact traditional pointed butcher knife with short wooden handle may show along the low outer right; never cover his face or add a rectangular cleaver.
Style: match the reference's polished 2D chibi anime game illustration, bold dark chocolate organic outlines, clean broad colour shapes, restrained warm cel shading. Very big expressive heads, playful comic appeal. No photorealism, no 3D or plastic appearance.
Background: simple full-bleed opaque deep jade green, one broad warm straw-gold peach-shaped backdrop behind the combined trio, two or three small pink peach petals in otherwise quiet corners. No battlefield scenery or extra people.
Constraints: exactly three heroes, no duplicates, no extra heads or disconnected hands, naturally attached short arms; no text, Chinese characters, title, logo, watermark, frame, UI, white outer margin or rounded-square border. No busy particles or small decorative props. Deliver one square production avatar.
processing: Resize original square to 512×512 using sharp; preserve composition; PNG compression level 9.
usage: Avatar is external profile artwork; logo is loaded by the hero-menu bundle. Public platform display name has not been submitted for change.
composition: Guan Yu upper left, Zhang Fei upper right, Liu Bei lower centre foreground; compact triangular group portrait.

logo.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: production transparent game title wordmark for a humorous chibi Chinese Three Kingdoms mobile game.
Primary request: create ONE standalone hand-painted Chinese title logo reading EXACTLY "桃园小英雄" in ONE horizontal line, five Chinese characters in this exact order: 桃 园 小 英 雄.
Input image: style reference ONLY. Match the LOWER LEFT existing title logo in the reference sprite sheet: warm cream/gold brush calligraphy on a rugged dark chocolate-brown ink-brush swash. Do not reproduce the old text, other sheet cells, any people, weapons, buttons or UI.
Design: bold playful heroic brush lettering, legible full strokes, energetic but balanced, restrained warm gold edge/shadow, slightly irregular hand-painted ink backdrop with rough brush ends. All five characters equally readable, no missing or merged strokes. Similar visual weight and palette to the existing logo, whimsical friendly Three Kingdoms game, no heavy 3D metal.
Composition: wide compact horizontal wordmark around 3:1 aspect ratio, generous transparent margin all around, no framing mockup. Brush swash remains behind the full title, characters do not touch canvas edges.
Text verbatim: 桃园小英雄
Constraints: genuine TRANSPARENT alpha outside the brown brush swash. No white/black rectangular background, no checkerboard baked in, no extra text, subtitle, Roman lettering, watermark, emblem, red seal, character illustration, blossom, outer frame or decorative weapons. Single final production logo only.
logo.processing: Trim transparent margins, resize to 640×181, RGBA PNG with alpha preserved.
